health_check.description: Verify server status and authentication. When authenticated, also reports the GitLab instance version from GET /api/v4/version (version, revision, enterprise). Version lookup failures do not fail the health check — those fields are omitted. Use this to verify server connectivity and authentication before making GitLab requests; use `whoami` when the authenticated user's identity is the goal. It does not mutate GitLab state and returns server/authentication status plus GitLab version details when available.
